catalog_selection.ordering: AllWISE W1 catalog magnitude ascending, numeric Gaia source_id ascending; lock before SPHEREx flux. No replacements after flux failures.
catalog_selection.neighbors: All returned AllWISE catalog entries, GaiaG<=20; positions propagated where measured PM exists. Unresolved/subthreshold blends remain unexcluded.

pair_selection.ranking: First by greatest footprint overlap/minimum corner displacement when polygons retained, then shortest separation>=1day, then URI; metadata/calibration only. Without polygons rank time then URI. Freeze ranking before downloads.
pair_selection.selection: First ranked pair whose recorded footprints cover>=3lockedcontrols with all per-control spectral/astrometry/support prerequisites. No flux values or residuals select a pair. One accepted pair per field/detector; no replacement after flux measurement.
pair_selection.spectral_gate: CWAVE/CBAND matched to release/detector/orientation and exact WCS-WAVE table identity; max center shift<=.25narrowerwidth, bandwidthratio>=.8 at control aperture footprint; full-field visual gate remains separate.
pair_selection.astrometry_gate: Independent native image peaks/Gaia association, no residual clipping;>=3stars per exposure, robustRMS includingbias<=1.5375arcsec. Use parent Phase3centroid method and freshGaia neighborhood.

measurement_methods.convergence_diagnostic: Photutils exact fractional intersection, same radius/background; not a posthoc replacement acceptance method
measurement_methods.psf_diagnostic: If release-matched EPSF available, compare predicted encircled-energy/pixel-phase effects and nativePSF amplitude+background. Diagnostic only; noPSFmethod adopted using these outcomes.
measurement_methods.annulus: Native pixel centers3<=r<=5, hard/warning/SOURCE excluded,>=10cleanpixels; no field-only fallback for acceptance
measurement_methods.field_background: Supported fixed production maskedmedian/heldoutplane; no new fitted normalization from controls
measurement_methods.mask: Hard and warning excluded; SOURCE retained in aperture only; complete nonzero-weight aperture support for all compared methods
measurement_methods.solid_angle: Use release-matched SAPM when available; report constant localWCS approximation separately and do not claim absolute totalflux calibration without correction
measurement_methods.no_tuning: No empirical error inflation, flux-scale fitting, residual clipping or threshold relaxation from holdout data

acceptance.five_subpixel_exact_convergence: For each retained measurement, |F5-Fexact|<=0.1*its approximate sigma; report all departures, no deletion
acceptance.global_gate: All measured valid cells must pass primarycandidate stability and convergence; require2fields and2detectors. Missingprerequisites/insufficientcells cannot be counted aspass.

limits: Engineering validation of scoped repeatability, not proof every catalog control is infraredconstant, absolutephotometric calibration, discovery significance, all-sky reliability or all detectors/releases
retention: Hash all rawFITS,catalogs,calibrations, queries and lockedIDs; preserve previous failedresults; researchcache ignored, no golden writes
